title: Wireless Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
description:
Professional Experience
• Minimum of 8 years of industry experience in wireless site reliability engineering, wireless network operations, or related areas.
• Solid understanding of underlying network and security components leveraged in wireless networks.
Core Responsibilities
• Wireless Protocols and Standards: Expert-level knowledge in 802.11ac/802.11ax and related standards including WPA, RADIUS, EAP, and 802.1X.
• Wireless Access Points & Controllers: Strong experience with WLAN controllers, particularly Mist Wireless.
• RF Design & Troubleshooting: Skilled in RF fundamentals, site surveys, spectrum analysis, and interference mitigation. Ability to build and interpret wireless heatmaps, tune for scalability and high availability, and optimize wireless networks for events.
• Networking Expertise: Deep knowledge of TCP/UDP, IPv4/IPv6, BGP, VPN, L2 switching, and proven background in network operations.

• Code Optimization: Ability to debug, optimize, and automate operational tasks.
• Platform Exposure: Experience with Mellanox/Cumulus or Linux, Mist Wireless, Cisco Wireless.
• Security Awareness: Hands-on experience with WLAN security platforms such as Cisco Client.

• Work with Tier 1 suppliers and understand mechanical system implementation.

• Proficiency in 3D CAD software CATIA
• 5+ years of experience
• Experience with ASME GD&T, tolerance stack up, and detailed 2D drawings
• Plastic and injection molding experience
• Experience with CAE tools (for example ANSYS)
• Knowledge of Thermal , Shock, and Vibration testing
• Knowledge of rapid prototyping
• Expertise in ADAS mechanical component design
• Track record of creative mechanical design that will fit within a tight space
• Knowledge of vehicle build and electrical harnessing

Education:
• Bachelor's of Science (Master's preferred), Mechanical Engineering or related engineering field

title: Plant Engineer
description:
Description:

Plant Engineering

Working in a regulated cGxP environment, identifies engineering needs for site facilities. Defines projects, develops innovative solutions, determines engineered solutions, develops project documentation, obtains capital or expense resources, obtains and evaluates competitive bids, and implements engineering changes/additions. Controls expenditures and project execution. Develops FDA validation protocols and data. Represent site as Facilities SME on capital projects.

Facility Infrastructure Management - Supports the efficient operation of site facility infrastructure systems (to include all utility systems, HVAC systems etc). Monitors all system status and analyzes to identify trends. Develops maintenance strategies and programs (preventative, corrective, predictive etc) to ensure cost effective and reliable operation of all plant equipment and systems. Facilitates business units' capability to perform their functions.

Administrative - Develops and manages capital and expense budgets. Researches information and presents data on a wide variety of facility related topics including planning of facility needs, master facilities maintenance plan, and the disaster recovery plan. Performs management functions, including managing performance and providing training and development opportunities for staff. Acts as qualified trainer for Facilities related SOP's, programs to support site training needs.

Energy Conservation - Analyzes energy consumption, identifies energy savings opportunities, develops appropriate projects and implements to improve energy conservation to achieve site, and corporate energy reduction goals. Develops cost and energy savings metrics and reports.

"Sustainable? Operations - Analyzes facilities processes and equipment to identify and implement opportunities to achieve Eco Team and Group Sustainability goals. Develops procedures, processes and/or projects to enhance sustainable operations at Bay Area sites.

Asset Management - Manage and maintain site asset listings, to include all buildings and grounds, utility infrastructure and equipment. Develop and manage Life Cycle Asset Management process, to include Facility Condition Assessments at each site. Proactively identify potential projects.
